title: 用Seedance 2.5做8秒文生视频来生成UGC风格的跑步App推广短片以适配TikTok投放
content:
用Seedance 2.5做8秒文生视频来生成UGC风格的跑步App推广短片以适配TikTok投放  
在提示词里明确镜头参数：Camera Angle: Handheld selfie stick extended selfie arm angle, looking back at the runner
tips:

en.content:
Use Seedance 2.5 to create an 8-second text-to-video clip in a UGC style for a running app promotional short, optimized for TikTok ads.  
In the prompt, clearly specify the camera parameters: Camera Angle: Handheld selfie stick extended selfie arm angle, looking back at the runner
